|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ブラステックＡｘ－１０８“グラウンド・バザー”ブラスター砲。宇宙船の引込み式ガン・ポッドから降下させて使用する。照準には動体センサーを使用。360°の射撃範囲を持つ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Surface Defense Cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any starfighter. Or deploy on Millennium Falcon without using Force. Target a character at the same location and use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny +1 exceeds ability.

'''Lore:'''
BlasTech Ax-108 Ground Buzzer blaster cannon. It is dropped from a retractable gun pod on a starship for use. Targeting uses a motion sensor. It has a 360-degree firing arc.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 位置 for site and 起動 for fire.
